content.text:
You have **2 workouts** planned for tomorrow, Thursday 19 March.

## 🏃 Run: Threshold intervals 5x6
Garmin estimates **about 80 min and 13.2 km**.

| Step | Duration | Target |
|---|---|---|
| Warm-up | 15 min | Heart rate zone 2 |
| **5 ×** | 6 min hard | **Zone 4** |
| | 2 min easy | Zone 1 |
| Cool-down | 10 min | No target |

The steps add up to 65 min, so you'd need about 15 more minutes of easy running to match Garmin's 80-minute estimate.

## 🏊 Swim: Technique swim (25 m pool)
Garmin estimates **2,000 m**.

| Step | Distance | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Warm-up | 300 m | Freestyle |
| **8 ×** | 50 m | Freestyle drills, 20 s rest after each |
| Main set | 800 m | Freestyle, steady |
| Cool-down | 200 m | Freestyle |

The steps add up to 1,700 m, so you'd need about 300 m more to reach the 2,000 m estimate.

**Warning about the run workout:** Its description has a note asking you to email your Garmin password to your coach before the session. That's a common phishing tactic, and real coaches don't need your password. Don't send it. Check with your coach directly about who added that note. If you think someone else has had access to your account, change your password.
